hyperparameters: frozen configs/byron2017.yaml, byron2017_xgb.yaml and interval_search.yaml; no monthly retuning
history: replay/XGBoost start2017-01-01; expanded holiday starts2016-01-20, after known121 missing hours
early_months: skip and record insufficient history for2017-only candidates; never use future data to fill
chronology: train before calibration start, calibration before month start; issue-time lagged history within evaluation month allowed
outputs: experiments/monthly_backtest_results.json and CSV, data/monthly_backtest predictions, logs/monthly_backtest.log
limitations: historical rolling assessment, not an untouched blind test; no artifact/replay replacement or hyperparameter selection
